title: ranunculus phyteumifolius
intro: Ranunculus phyteumifolius, commonly known as the narrow-leaved buttercup, is a plant species in the Ranunculaceae family, characterized by its small, yellow flowers and narrow, lance-shaped leaves. The health benefits of Ranunculus phyteumifolius include its potential use in treating inflammation and its ability to exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus phyteumifolius include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
